name: Sevenfold Transmutation
description:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Sucrose.
Summon Large Wind Spirit.
While Large Wind Spirit is on the field, characters on your side with  Talent attached deal +1 DMG.
(You must have Sucrose in your deck to add this card to your deck.)

storytext: "Reproducibility is the cornerstone of any experiment. That's why the 'Mimic Demon King' mentioned in the third volume of the original work is, honestly... rather unsound. A single experiment can't prove that the swarm intelligence of the mold falls below standard expectations, and the rules about changes after inhaling the spore dust were never clearly defined. I must have been completely out of my mind at the time. Please, don't follow my example..."
